A per-comparison one-sided rate of 0.05 over ten comparisons would give a family-wise rate of about 1 - 0.95**10 = 0.401, WHICH IS FAR TOO HIGH TO REPORT AS A DISCOVERY THRESHOLD, and BATCH-027's own OBJ-RT082-3 exists because exactly this arithmetic was left to the reader. THE BOTH-CELLS REQUIREMENT IN C-WIDE AND C-TIGHT IS THE ANSWER AND IT IS ADOPTED IN ADVANCE - it reduces the per-rung false-declaration probability to at most 0.05**2 = 0.0025 and the family-wise rate over five rungs to at most 1 - (1 - 0.0025)**5 = 0.01243. The cost in power is stated below and not hidden. THE CELLS ARE TREATED AS INDEPENDENT FOR THIS ARITHMETIC AND THAT IS AN APPROXIMATION - the 20 fresh instances at bits 16 and at bits 20 are generated from the SAME 20 master seeds, so a seed-level effect would correlate the two cells and the true both-cells rate could exceed 0.0025. THIS IS DECLARED HERE RATHER THAN DISCOVERED LATER, and the run must report whether the per-seed p_hat residuals at the two cells are correlated so the size of the approximation is measurable.

attainability.duty: THE ONE GENUINELY NEW DUTY OF THIS BATCH. Branch-attainability has no object; this replaces it and is strictly harder because it is authored fresh rather than carried. Every number below is DERIVED ARITHMETIC from the chi-square distribution, is computable by anyone from k alone, and is NOT a measurement of anything.
attainability.the_sampling_law: OBJ-REAL IS EXHAUSTIVE AND THEREFORE HAS NO WITHIN-INSTANCE SAMPLING NOISE AT ALL - the frozen specification states this. So p_hat(u) at a single instance is a DETERMINISTIC number and there is EXACTLY ONE NOISE SOURCE IN THIS DESIGN, THE INSTANCE. That is what makes the measurement clean: s_between over k instances estimates the only variance component that exists, with (k-1) * s**2 / sigma**2 distributed as chi-square on nu = k - 1 degrees of freedom under the working normal approximation for p_hat across instances.
attainability.k_is_fixed_at_20_per_cell: FIXED HERE, BEFORE ANY DATUM. nu = 19. Any increase requires a versioned protocol_amendment recorded before the second run.
attainability.interval_multipliers: chi-square(0.95, 19) = 30.1435 and chi-square(0.05, 19) = 10.1170, so the two-sided 90 percent interval for sigma is [s * sqrt(19/30.1435), s * sqrt(19/10.1170)] = [s * 0.79392, s * 1.37041]. The relative standard error of s at k = 20 is 1/sqrt(2 * (k-1)) = 0.1622, i.e. plus or minus about 16 percent at one sd.
attainability.detection_floors_derived: Declaring sigma_between > s_iid at one-sided 95 percent requires VR >= 1/0.79392 = 1.2596. Declaring sigma_between < s_iid requires VR <= 1/1.37041 = 0.7297. SO AT k = 20 THE DESIGN CANNOT RESOLVE A BAND INFLATION BELOW ABOUT 26 PERCENT, AND THAT IS DECLARED IN ADVANCE RATHER THAN DISCOVERED AFTERWARDS.
attainability.the_argument_that_k_equals_20_IS_ENOUGH_: THE ALTERNATIVE THAT MATTERS IS NOT A 26 PERCENT INFLATION. OBJ-RT082-1's route (a) is that a nonzero first-order projection puts the EFFECTIVE sample size nearer 512 than 130816, which corresponds to VR of order sqrt(130816/512) = 15.98 - THE FACTOR OF SIXTEEN THE GOAL RECORD NAMES. The design's declaration floor is 1.2596. THE ALTERNATIVE THAT WOULD VACATE THE ENTIRE DETECTION-FLOOR TABLE SITS A FACTOR OF ABOUT 12.7 ABOVE THE FLOOR, so k = 20 separates VR = 1 from VR = 16 with essentially certainty.

power_table_derived_not_measured.VR_true_1.26: one cell about 0.50 by construction; both cells about 0.25

power_table_derived_not_measured.how_computed: Declare-wide iff s >= 1.2596 * s_iid, i.e. iff chi-square(19) >= 19 * (1.2596/VR_true)**2. The four thresholds are 0.1178, 1.8840, 7.5358 and 13.397 respectively; both-cells power is the square under the independence approximation declared above.

attainability.honest_statement_of_what_k_equals_20_buy: IT BUYS A DECISIVE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION ACTUALLY ASKED - is the yardstick wrong by a factor of order sixteen, or by a factor of order one - AND IT DOES NOT BUY a resolution of the yardstick to better than about 26 percent. If the answer comes back inside [0.73, 1.26] at every rung, the correct report is that the iid band is not shown to be wrong by more than about a quarter in either direction at k = 20, WHICH IS A MATERIALLY DIFFERENT AND MUCH WEAKER STATEMENT THAN `the band is correct`, and EV-IVR-001 must write the weaker one.

C_REPRO_1_yardstick_free_and_primary_for.clause: Report z_2301(cell, u) = (p_hat_2301(cell, u) - mean of the 20 fresh p_hat values) / s_between(cell, u), and the RANK of the 2301 value among the 21 values, at every quantity and cell. The bits-16 u = 2 archived 2301 value is 0.3562102495107632.
C_REPRO_1_yardstick_free_and_primary_for.why_it_is_the_right_test: IT USES NO CALIBRATION BAND AT ALL AND IS THEREFORE NOT CIRCULAR. The BATCH-027 reject was a comparison of one instance against an iid band whose applicability is the thing under test; this compares that same instance against 20 instances of the same construction, using the noise scale those 20 instances actually exhibit. Because OBJ-REAL is exhaustive there is no within-instance noise to confound it.
C_REPRO_1_yardstick_free_and_primary_for.pre_registered_readings: If the shortfall were a property of THE CONSTRUCTION, z_2301 is near zero and the whole fresh family sits low against the archived uniform mean - which C-MEAN measures. If the shortfall were an accident OF THE 2301 INSTANCE, z_2301 is a low outlier within the fresh family and C-MEAN is unremarkable. If the shortfall were the band being too narrow, z_2301 is unremarkable AND VR is large. THESE THREE ARE DISTINGUISHABLE BY THIS DESIGN AND THAT IS THE DESIGN'S POINT; the rank of 2301 among 21 is reported for each, and no reading is chosen after the fact.

C_REPRO_2_yardstick_dependent_secondary_.clause: Report the COUNT of the 20 fresh instances whose p_hat(16, u=2) lies strictly below the archived lower band edge 0.3562408268101761.
C_REPRO_2_yardstick_dependent_secondary_.pre_registered_arithmetic: Under a no-offset null the per-instance probability of landing below the 2nd ascending order statistic of 200 calibration replicates is at most 2/201 = 0.00995, so the expected count over 20 instances is about 0.199. Binomial(20, 0.00995) gives P(X >= 2) = 0.0167 and P(X >= 3) = 0.00097. A COUNT OF 3 OR MORE IS A ONE-IN-A-THOUSAND EVENT UNDER THE NO-OFFSET NULL AND IS DECLARED SO IN ADVANCE.
C_REPRO_2_yardstick_dependent_secondary_.the_circularity_declared_rather_than_hid: THIS CLAUSE PRESUMES THE VERY BAND UNDER TEST. Its arithmetic is valid only if VR is near 1, so it MAY NOT BE QUOTED WITHOUT THE MEASURED VR AT THE SAME CELL AND RUNG BESIDE IT, and if C-WIDE fires at bits-16 u = 2 this clause's arithmetic is void and must be reported as void. C-REPRO-1 is the primary and this is the secondary; that ordering is fixed here and not after the fact. THE TIE CAVEAT ALSO TRAVELS - the 1st and 2nd ascending order statistics at that site are tied, so the achieved low-side rate is at most 1/201 and 2/201 is an upper bound, exactly as RR-LPF-2's band_provenance.tie_caveat_declared records.

C_MEAN_reported_and_expressly_not_read.clause: Report t(cell, u) = (mean of the 20 fresh p_hat values - the archived uniform null mean at that cell and rung) / (s_between / sqrt(20)), on 19 degrees of freedom, at every quantity and cell. The bits-16 u = 2 archived null mean is 0.35907492202788643.
C_MEAN_reported_and_expressly_not_read.why_it_is_computed: BECAUSE THE DATA WILL EXIST AND REFUSING TO COMPUTE AN OBVIOUS STATISTIC FROM ARCHIVED ARRAYS SO THAT NOBODY CAN LOOK AT IT IS NOT RIGOUR. It is the test the original design could not perform, because the original design had one instance and therefore no estimate of the instance noise scale.
C_MEAN_reported_and_expressly_not_read.why_it_is_NOT_READ_IN_THIS_BATCH: BECAUSE READING IT WOULD BE ADJUDICATING H-LPF-001 THROUGH A STATISTIC NO FROZEN READING RULE COVERS, WHICH IS EXACTLY THE MOVE THIS PROGRAM FORBIDS. RR-IVR-1 assigns C-MEAN no licence, no threshold and no disposition. EV-IVR-001 reports the numbers and states in terms that they are OBSERVATIONS ONLY and that no conclusion about HEUR-DS-1, H-LPF-001 or the Semaev map follows from them in either direction. The successor contract that would read them is RANKED, named in the close, and is not this batch. ABS-REL-LPF-1 travels with the report, and CAL-LPF-1 travels with the reference - the archived uniform mean is a calibration quantity and is non-evidential about any hypothesis.

free_rider.what: For each of the 512 factor-base elements, the smooth fraction over its 511 pairs, at every instance, cell and powered rung.
free_rider.the_closed_form_comparison: Compare the sd of the 512 rates with sqrt(p_bar * (1 - p_bar) / 511). If the dispersion exceeds it, the first-order projection is nonzero, the effective sample size is below 130816 and the iid band is provably too narrow. The relative standard error of a dispersion statistic on 512 values is 1/sqrt(2 * 511) = 0.0313, SO THIS INSTRUMENT IS FIVE TIMES SHARPER THAN THE k = 20 BETWEEN-INSTANCE SD - it resolves a first-order projection at about the 5 to 7 percent level against the 26 percent floor of VR.
free_rider.why_the_closed_form_alone_is_not_enough_: THE 512 RATES ARE NOT INDEPENDENT. Each pair (i, j) enters exactly two of them, so the 512 x 511 incidence structure induces dependence that sqrt(p(1-p)/511) does not model, and a dispersion ratio read against the closed form alone would be an uncontrolled statistic - the exact failure docs/inventor-protocol.md section 3 names. THE REPAIR IS A PERMUTATION NULL AND IT COSTS NO FACTORIZATION AT ALL - permute the 130816 smooth indicators across the 130816 pair slots R_PERM = 2000 times, holding the incidence structure and the total smooth count fixed, and recompute the dispersion each time. Under the null of no first-order projection the indicators are exchangeable across pairs, so this null is exact conditionally on the total, and it is the identical measurement against a null object of the same shape. BOTH the closed-form ratio and the permutation-null position must be reported; neither may be reported alone.
free_rider.W3_makes_this_non_redundant: THE FREE RIDER AND THE BETWEEN-INSTANCE SD ARE NOT SUBSTITUTES AND MAY NOT BE TRADED OFF. The free rider sees FIRST-ORDER structure only. A purely second-order, pair-level dependence would leave the 512 per-index rates at exactly their exchangeable dispersion while still inflating the between-instance sd. A CLEAN FREE RIDER THEREFORE DOES NOT LICENSE ANY STATEMENT ABOUT VR, and a large VR with a clean free rider is a coherent and informative outcome that must be reported as such rather than as a contradiction.

PRE_Q_1_that_the_contract_must_answer_fr.question: Does generate_instance(seed, bits) vary the prime p, or only the curve coefficients at a p fixed by bits?
PRE_Q_1_that_the_contract_must_answer_fr.why_it_must_be_answered_before_the_datum: BECAUSE IT CHANGES WHAT THE BETWEEN-INSTANCE SD IS THE STANDARD DEVIATION OF. The frozen factor base is `the first 512 x-coordinates in F_p in increasing integer order`, which depends ONLY on p. If p is fixed by bits, all 20 instances share ONE factor base and the variation is across CURVES at fixed p and fixed base - in which case RT049-B6 bites harder, the small-x window is literally identical across all 20, and the free rider's first-order projection is measured on ONE base only. If p varies, the variation is across (p, curve) pairs and the base varies too.
PRE_Q_1_that_the_contract_must_answer_fr.duty: TASK-20260802-003 must answer this FROM SOURCE, state the answer in the frozen contract, and state in RR-IVR-1 which of the two quantities the measurement is. TASK-20260802-005 must verify the answer from source independently. The run must report the 20 primes and the 20 factor_base_sha256 values per cell so the answer is checkable from the archive. reading_rule_rr_ivr_1.substitution_rule_fixed_in_advance: If generate_instance(seed, bits) fails for a seed in 90001-90020, or if two seeds yield instances identical in every varying component, the DETERMINISTIC pre-registered replacement is the next unused integer upward from 90021, applied in increasing order until 20 distinct instances exist at that cell. If more than 5 substitutions are needed at either cell, that is reported as an anomaly and the reason is investigated in the execution report; it does not by itself fire I-0.
